text:
olivia_csm: Quick heads-up — prepping QBR for AtlasPay next Tue 3pm PT. Need a tight deck that focuses on adoption signals, onboarding velocity, and a frank renewal risk assessment. Sharing the draft here: https://redwoodhq.slides/s/atlaspay-qbr-draft :point_down:

maria_cs: I can own adoption metrics and the onboarding slide. Can you add latest activation funnel numbers? I pulled partials but need the full cohort retention by week. :memo:

aj_dev: happy to take the demo / live fallback slide. Need eng to confirm who can join the QBR for the live demo — can't promise on-call folks but I can cover the script.

sam_eng: we should include the recent latency regression note and mitigation timeline. I'll get the 95th/99th percentile numbers from infra. @devops-bot any latest SLO exports I can paste?

devops-bot: Export ready — SLO snapshot (2025-06-01): 95p=210ms, 99p=560ms, error_rate=0.13%. Paste token: slo-20250601-xyz

olivia_csm: nice — that SLO line will help with the "reliability" ask. I'm also adding a slide for customer feedback themes (security, onboarding docs, trial-to-paid conversion). Maria, can you capture top 3 adoption blockers?

maria_cs: top 3 blockers from CS notes: 1) initial API key rotation confusion 2) model selection defaults causing cost surprises 3) missing onboarding checklist for dedicated customers. I'll draft mitigation bullets and owners.

aj_dev: for the model defaults item, we should show a quick cost-vs-latency tradeoff table. I'll add one slide with recommended presets and rollout plan (canary + telemetry).

olivia_csm: Adding an "Exec asks" slide — want to be explicit: 1) approval to run a targeted adoption campaign, 2) commit to 2 engineer hours/week for demo & bug fixes for next 8 weeks, 3) signoff on pricing guardrails. Does that align?

sam_eng: aligns. For the engineer hours ask, can we scope it as "2 FTE-hours/week from Eng Platform for runbook & demo stability" — less scary phrasing for execs.

olivia_csm: good call, will reword. Also creating a short appendix with rollout timeline and fallback plan (if latency spike during demo, fallback to recorded demo + screenshare).

maria_cs: action items I captured so far:
- Maria: final adoption slide + top blockers + mitigation bullets (due Fri 10am PT)
- Aj: cost vs latency presets + demo script (due Mon EOD)
- Sam: SLO + appendix latency graph (due Mon EOD)
- Olivia: Exec asks slide + invite + rehearsal schedule (scheduling now)

calendar-bot: Meeting created: QBR — AtlasPay | Tue Jun 3 2025 15:00 PT | 30m — olivia_csm, maria_cs, aj_dev, sam_eng — https://calendar.redwood/qbr-atlaspay

olivia_csm: can we rehearse Tue 9am PT for 20 minutes? If that works I'll lock it. Also heads-up — recommend keeping the deck to 10 slides max and have a one-slide appendix for technicals.

aj_dev: 9am rehearsal works for me. I'll prep the demo fallback video just in case. :thumbsup:

sam_eng: same, will be on the call. I'll upload the latency png to the deck link above when ready.

maria_cs: will aim to have my slide + the top blockers doc in the shared deck by Fri 10am. If any blockers on data I'll ping.

olivia_csm: perfect. Final ask — please flag any renewal risks that need an executive PSA (legal, billing, or contract terms) before rehearsal. We want to be transparent but not alarmist.

aj_dev: nothing legal on my side. billing? we did see a few customers with overage disputes last month, might be worth a one-liner.

maria_cs: noted — I'll add a renewal-risk heatmap and call out billing disputes as "monitoring + CS outreach".

olivia_csm: thanks team — I'll assemble v0.2 of the deck with these changes and post here for a quick pass before rehearsal. :rocket:
